Summary.en: Turns a textarea into a rich-text editor powered by TinyMCE.
Summary.de: Verwandelt eine Textarea in einen Rich-Text-Editor auf Basis von TinyMCE.
Summary.it: Trasforma una textarea in un editor di testo formattato basato su TinyMCE.

Parameter.Plugins: A CSV of TinyMCE plugin names to load (e.g. 'advlist, autolink, lists, link, image, table, code').
Parameter.Toolbar: The toolbar configuration string defining which buttons and groups to display (e.g. 'undo redo | blocks | bold italic forecolor | bullist numlist | table | code').
Parameter.ResourceURL: The base URL where the TinyMCE distribution is served (must contain tinymce.min.js, skins/, icons/, models/ and plugins/ subdirectories).
Parameter.UploadURL: The server endpoint URL for file uploads (e.g. TTBoard_UPLOAD?uid=). Used by the codbiuploadfile toolbar button.
Parameter.UploadImageURL: The server endpoint URL for image uploads. Falls back to UploadURL if not set.
Parameter.UploadFieldName: The name of the form field for the uploaded file (default: fileToUpload).
Parameter.StripPort: If set to 'true', the port number (e.g. :444) is removed from the URL returned by the upload server before inserting it into the editor.
Parameter.RenderToPdf: If set to 'true', a print-listener is registered that replaces the document body with the plain-text content of this editor when the form is printed/exported to PDF.

Plugins.default: A CSV of TinyMCE plugin names to load (e.g. 'advlist, autolink, lists, link, image, table, code').

Toolbar.default: The toolbar configuration string defining which buttons and groups to display (e.g. 'undo redo | blocks | bold italic forecolor | bullist numlist | table | code').

ResourceURL.default: The base URL where the TinyMCE distribution is served (must contain tinymce.min.js, skins/, icons/, models/ and plugins/ subdirectories).

UploadURL.default: The server endpoint URL for file uploads (e.g. TTBoard_UPLOAD?uid=). Used by the codbiuploadfile toolbar button.

UploadImageURL.default: The server endpoint URL for image uploads. Falls back to UploadURL if not set.

UploadFieldName.default: The name of the form field for the uploaded file (default: fileToUpload).

StripPort.default: if set to 'true', the port number (e.g. :444) is removed from the url returned by the upload server before inserting it into the editor.

RenderToPdf.default: if set to 'true', a print-listener is registered that replaces the document body with the plain-text content of this editor when the form is printed/exported to pdf.
